programme.title: Meg 2: The depth / Meg 2: Die Tiefe
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor takes his research team to an exploration dive into the deepest areas of the ocean. However, a backless company for underwater mining also thrown an eye on the diving area when looking for valuable raw materials. Due to her unscrupulous approach, huge prahoric sharks are lured from the dark depths of the ancient ecosystem and Taylors Crew can be found in a struggle for survival. / Jonas Taylor fuhrt sein Forschungsteam auf einen Erkundungstauchgang in die tiefsten Bereiche des Ozeans. Allerdings hat auch ein rucksichtsloses Unternehmen fur Unterwasserbergbau bei der Suche nach wertvollen Rohstoffen ein Auge auf das Tauchgebiet geworfen. Durch ihr skrupelloses Vorgehen werden riesige prahistorische Haie aus den finsteren Tiefen des uralten Ökosystems gelockt und Taylors Crew findet sich in einem Kampf ums Überleben wieder.

programme.title: Meg / Meg
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor is an experienced deep -sea diver who specializes in salvages. When a submarine drops after the attack of a 20-meter-long giant shark, Jonas is called. Together with the daughter of a marine researcher, he dares to dare to overcome his trauma, because he already had to deal with the primeval monster. But to save the trapped people, he takes it up again with him. / Jonas Taylor ist ein erfahrener Tiefseetaucher, der auf Bergungen spezialisiert ist. Als ein U-Boot nach dem Angriff eines 20 Meter langen Riesenhais sinkt, wird Jonas gerufen. Gemeinsam mit der Tochter eines Meeresforschers wagt er sich in die Tiefe und muss dabei sein Trauma uberwinden, denn er hatte es bereits einmal mit dem urzeitlichen Monster zu tun. Doch um die eingeschlossenen Menschen zu retten, nimmt er es erneut mit ihm auf.

programme.title: The Expendables 3 / The Expendables 3

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk und der schlafende Verdachtige
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Listen to interesting interviews with some of the largest Names Premier League. Saznajte sve o razmišljanjima ovih poznatih fudbalera, njihovom pristupu igri, budućim planovima i još mnogo toga!

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: World Rhythmic Gymnastics Championships: Finals of appliances / Световно първенство по художествена гимнастика: Финали на уреди
programme.desc: Beautiful sport has attracted the attention of many viewers because of the great Bulgarian success over the years. In the Brazilian city, our country will be represented by the European vice -champion this year and the winner of 3 gold medals on the Stiliana Nikolova and Eva Brezalieva, who will participate in the individual race. The ensemble, with coach Vesela Dimitrova, will also fight for a place among the best in the huge competition of 36 groups. The Championship in Brazil will gather over 300 gymnasts from a record 76 countries. The event seems to be the beginning of a new era in sports-with new combinations, updated groups and young hopes that will fight for a place among the best in the world. The World Cup in Rio will offer not only contested sports race, but also inspiration, artistry and emotion-qualities that make rhythmic gymnastics one of the most watched sports in the world. / Красивият спорт привлича вниманието на множество зрители, заради големите български успехи през годините. В бразилския град страната ни ще бъде представена от европейската вицешампионка от тази година и носителка на 3 златни медала на уредите Стилияна Николова и Ева Брезалиева, които ще участват в индивидуалната надпревара. Ансамбълът, с треньор Весела Димитрова, също ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в огромната конкуренция от 36 състава. Шампионатът в Бразилия ще събере над 300 гимнастички от рекордните 76 държави. Събитието сякаш бележи началото на нова ера в спорта – с нови съчетания, обновени състави и млади надежди, които ще се борят за място сред най-добрите в света. Световното първенство в Рио ще предложи не само оспорвана спортна надпревара, но и вдъхновение, артистизъм и емоция – качества, които правят художествената гимнастика един от най-гледаните спортове в света.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: It all starts in an ordinary morning in high school of a small town. Anonymous people with unicorns and pistol masks invade and begin to shoot everyone. Four students were killed and there were many injured. The terrorist act was carried out during a ceremony dedicated to the day of the dead in the wars and victims of terror. The nightmare happened changes people's lives. Police are launching an investigation. The experienced and harsh detective Davidi is taken over by him. They find a shocking fact-people with masks are most likely students from the same school. Interrogations begin and one must understand who is lying on purpose, who just doesn't remember anything, and what is the reason for the terrible events. / Всичко започва в една обикновена сутрин в гимназията на един малък град. Анонимни хора с маски на еднорози и пистолети нахлуват и започват да стрелят по всички. Четирима ученици са убити и има много ранени. Терористичният акт е извършен по време на церемония, посветена на Деня на загиналите във войните и жертвите на терора. Случилият се кошмар променя живота на хората. Полицията започва разследване. Поема го опитният и суров детектив Давиди. Откриват шокиращ факт – хората с маските най-вероятно са ученици от същото училище. Започват разпити и трябва да се разбере кой лъже нарочно, кой просто не помни нищо и коя е причината за ужасните събития.

Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Football: UEFA European Women's Championship 2025: Finals: England - Spain / Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Финал: Англия - Испания
programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. The team of England will defend its title, won 3 years ago on home land. The biggest competitors are the world champions from Spain, who are the team with the most front ranking in Europe in the FIFA rankings- second place. The German squad, which lost the final 3 years ago, is a record holder for European victories, triumphed 8 times in the previous 13 editions, but their last title has been in 2013 in the top ten of the world rankings are the teams of Sweden and France. / 16-те най-добри дамски отбора на континента се събират в Швейцария, за да се борят за купата в 14-ия европейски шампионат. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. В първата десетка на световната ранглиста са още отборите на Швеция и Франция.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a Championship Cup was founded, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.desc: Womens EHF Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The 1924/2025 Champions League brings a new opportunity to top handball clubs to show their quality and fight for the prestigious title of Europe champions. programme.desc: Coppa Italia - (Sport. Program, Italy) The Italian Cup has been tailoring its history since 1922 and its first edition. Pomalo kuriozitetan podatak je slabija posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na Serie A zbog tradicije odmaranja ponajboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih momčadi. No, sve to pada u vodu prilikom završnice turnira kada se pobjedniku osigurava sigurno mjesto u skupinama UEFA Europa lige. Tada interes za ovo natjecanje rapidno raste. programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Qualification - (Sport. Program, 2025) The most respected European football competition, Champions League, with the group stage of the competition begins in September. The Champions League qualifications consist of pre -qualification, two qualifying rounds and the final playoffs to enter the competition. The clubs are ranked according to the coefficient of the previous seasons, and on the basis of it they enter the earlier or later phase of qualifying ... / UEFA Champions League Qualification - (sport. program, 2025) Najcjenjenije europsko nogometno natjecanje, Liga prvaka, s grupnom fazom natjecanja počinje u rujnu. programme.title: Manchester United - Real Sociedad, Nogomet, Europe Liga / Manchester United - Real Sociedad, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: PSG - Arsenal, Football, Champions League / Psg - Arsenal, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Rangers - Fenerbahce, Football, Europa League / Rangers - Fenerbahce, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Dubrava Tim Kabel - Karlovac 1919, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 2nd round / Dubrava Tim Kabel - Karlovac 1919, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 2. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: After years without contact, chief criminal commissioner Felix Voss (Fabian Hinrichs) is one day called by his old friend Marcus Borchert (Pirmin Sedlmeier), who is now a pastor. Marcus ladets Felix to the Sunday sermon. He wants to reveal something about Antonia Hentschel (Sina Martens). Antonia, called Toni, was Felix Groß's love during his studies in Berlin. But it does not happen: Marcus is found murdered shortly before. Felix learns that Toni committed suicide two years ago. The local police suspect that the murder of Marcus is a predatory murder. But Felix believes that there is a connection between Toni's death and Marcus. Despite everyone, he begins to investigate. He receives support from Paula Ringelhahn (Dagmar Manzel) and Wanda Goldwasser (Eli Wasserscheid). Felix meets Toni's family, who was also invited to Marcus sermon. Toni's father Johannes Hentschel (Andre Jung) is a medium -sized industrialist who has made his family business into one of the most important suppliers of the auto industry in recent decades. Felix does everything possible to clear the death of Toni and Marcus and continue to penetrate the Hentschel family. / Nach Jahren ohne Kontakt wird Kriminalhauptkommissar Felix Voss (Fabian Hinrichs) eines Tages uberraschenderweise von seinem alten Freund Marcus Borchert (Pirmin Sedlmeier) angerufen, der inzwischen Pfarrer ist. Marcus ladt Felix zur Sonntagspredigt ein. Er will etwas uber Antonia Hentschel (Sina Martens) enthullen. Antonia, genannt Toni, war Felix groSSe Liebe wahrend seiner Studienzeit in Berlin. Doch zu der Predigt kommt es nicht: Marcus wird kurz vorher ermordet aufgefunden. Noch am Tatort erfahrt Felix, dass sich Toni vor zwei Jahren das Leben genommen hat. Die ortliche Polizei vermutet, dass es sich bei dem Mord an Marcus um einen Raubmord handelt. Doch Felix ist der Meinung, dass es eine Verbindung zwischen dem Tod von Toni und von Marcus gibt. Allen Widerstanden zum Trotz beginnt er zu ermitteln. Unterstutzung bekommt er dabei von Paula Ringelhahn (Dagmar Manzel) und Wanda Goldwasser (Eli Wasserscheid). Felix lernt Tonis Familie kennen, die auch zu Marcus Predigt eingeladen war. Tonis Vater Johannes Hentschel (Andre Jung) ist ein mittelstandischer Industrieller, der in den letzten Jahrzehnten seinen Familienbetrieb zu einem der wichtigsten Zulieferer der Autoindustrie gemacht hat. Felix setzt alles daran, den Tod von Toni und Marcus aufzuklaren und dringt so immer weiter in die Abgrunde der Familie Hentschel vor.

programme.title: Maria Wern, Kripo Gotland - Shadow of the past / Maria Wern, Kripo Gotland - Schatten der Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Young people discover a car with a decayed body in a lake. To the trouble of Commissioner Maria Wern (Eva Rose), her new boss Annika Fåhreus (Katrin Sundberg) immediately passes on the story to the media. At the music academy, the criminal team is on the identity of the dead: Sandra Nygård (Didi Cederstrom), a former student and famous party queen. The sexual criminal lars Nordgren (Oskar Thunberg), who has only recently been on the freely free foot, was suspected of having traces on Gotland. Together with her partner Sebastian Ståhl (Erik Johansson), Maria sets off to Stockholm to search for the undercarded outdoor gang. However, their investigations also drove to the dark side of the victim. When they find out that Sandra has blackmailed several men, they come across the right trip. Meanwhile, Arvidsson (Peter Perski) is trying to repair the relationship of his daughter Iris (Tehilla Blad) to her friend Alexander (David Arnesen). However, he has no idea that this is not a good idea ... / Jugendliche entdecken in einem See ein Auto mit einer verwesten Leiche. Zum Ärger von Kommissarin Maria Wern (Eva Rose) gibt ihre neue Chefin Annika Fåhreus (Katrin Sundberg) die Story sofort an die Medien weiter. An der Musikhochschule stoSSt das Kripoteam auf die Identitat der Toten: Sandra Nygård (Didi Cederstrom), eine ehemalige Studentin und beruchtigte Partyqueen. Unter Verdacht gerat der Sexualstraftater Lars Nordgren (Oskar Thunberg), der erst seit Kurzem auf freiem FuSS ist und moglicherweise auf Gotland seine Spuren beseitigt hat. Zusammen mit ihrem Partner Sebastian Ståhl (Erik Johansson) bricht Maria nach Stockholm auf, um dort nach dem untergetauchten Freiganger zu suchen. Ihre Ermittlungen fuhren jedoch auch zur dunklen Seite des Opfers. Als sie herausfinden, dass Sandra mehrere Manner erpresst hat, stoSSen sie auf die richtige Fahrte. Unterdessen versucht Arvidsson (Peter Perski), die Beziehung seiner Tochter Iris (Tehilla Blad) zu ihrem Freund Alexander (David Arnesen) zu reparieren. programme.desc: At the first time you are free, Frank Michalka (Jurgen Vogel) brings a bank again. The criminal act in the Nahe, apathetically, and let the police arrest, as if he wanted to get back into prison. There you think you know him without really knowing anything about the terrifying single gang. Only Sophie Kleinschmidt (Paula Kalenberg), committed legal clerkship in the law firm of the defense lawyer, succeeds in breaking his silence. From an African children's song to Tranen, Michalka raises his sad life story. This is about a lot of suffering in Germany and a delightful fresh start in Ethiopia. Friends like Dr. Kidanu (Selam Tadese) and his wife Ayantu (Sayat Demissie), who does not respond to letters from the prison. The election Äthiopier is eagerly able to explain why he could not return to her from a visit to the German Embassy. Now the repetition stator threatens an even longer punishment if there is no miracle in the courtroom. During Michalka paralyzes hardly a word, defender Weilandt (Thomas Thieme) must pull all the stops. But with the clear evidence there is only hope when judge Pieper (Nina Proll) and prosecutor Zinnecker (Robert Gwisdek) play along. And Michalka himself has the strength to get a new chance for a new chance. / Gleich beim ersten Freigang uberfallt Frank Michalka (Jurgen Vogel) wieder eine Bank. Apathisch bricht der Straftater in der Nahe zusammen und lasst sich von der Polizei festnehmen, als wollte er zuruck ins Gefangnis. Dort glaubt man ihn zu kennen, ohne wirklich etwas uber den furchteinfloSSenden Einzelganger zu wissen. Erst Sophie Kleinschmidt (Paula Kalenberg), engagierte Referendarin in der Kanzlei des Pflichtverteidigers, gelingt es, sein Schweigen zu brechen. Von einem afrikanischen Kinderlied zu Tranen geruhrt, erzahlt Michalka seine traurige Lebensgeschichte. Diese handelt von viel Leid in Deutschland und einem glucklichen Neuanfang in Äthiopien. Dort leben Freunde wie Dr. Kidanu (Selam Tadese) und seine Frau Ayantu (Sayat Demissie), die auf Briefe aus dem Gefangnis nicht antwortet. Sehnlich wunscht sich der Wahl-Äthiopier, erklaren zu konnen, warum er von einem Besuch in der deutschen Botschaft nicht zu ihr zuruckkehren konnte. Nun droht dem Wiederholungstater eine noch langere Strafe, wenn im Gerichtssaal nicht ein Wunder geschieht. Wahrend Michalka paralysiert kaum ein Wort sagen kann, muss Verteidiger Weilandt (Thomas Thieme) alle Register ziehen. Doch bei der eindeutigen Beweislage gibt es nur Hoffnung, wenn Richterin Pieper (Nina Proll) und Staatsanwalt Zinnecker (Robert Gwisdek) mitspielen. Und Michalka selbst die Kraft aufbringt, fur eine neue Chance zu kampfen.

programme.title: Netherlands unfiltered: Who are you really? / Niederlande ungefiltert: Wer seid ihr wirklich?
programme.desc: It is one of the most popular holidaylanders in Germans. Schone Kusten, lively and picturesque inner city, wind -embossed landscapes. Millions of Germans go on vacation in the Netherlands every year. The people there: nice, open and uncomplicated, at least the picture that many Germans take away from their vacation trips. "For a long time, my impression was that what spills out of the Netherlands to us is colorful, colorful and sometimes a little bit," says ARD correspondent Tobias Reckmann. But: in the last parliamentary election, 26 percent of Niederlander elected right -wing populist parties, especially many of Geert Wilder's party; It has been a big one in Dutch politics for years. So are our neighbors not so colorful and tolerant? How do you really tick? ARD-Niederland correspondent Tobias Reckmann wants to look behind the scenes of the holiday facade and travels for Volendam. The small town is located at the gates of Amsterdam, is characterized by land and a stronghold of right -wing populists. Fisch seller Jaap Schilder's family has been living here for generations. He would like to look back at a time without an EU fish caught rate - and especially without a Windrader in the North Sea. "I preferred to tear it off again," he says. And even otherwise, if you stroll through the place with him, you will find the attitude "EVERYONE was better". Farmers who do not want to switch their companies to climate -friendly. Pensioners who enforce that immigrants steal their bicycles, and football fans who find it good to be a conspiratorial community in which not everyone can just participate. Wherever the longing for early comes, the desire to turn the bike again instead of going back further? Many report many reports of a rapid change in the past decades. Extreme population growth and influx - now every third in the Netherlands has a migration background. The country lacks 400,000 apartments. Jack Deen and Donna Schilders do not find any apartment - they are in their mid -20s, have full -time jobs and still cannot afford the excerpt from home. Like you, thousands are possible. What perspective do you have? A few kilometers from Volendam is Amsterdam. The colorful, lively metropolis that is visited by millions of tourists every year. But from those who are on the move in the center and along the canals, hardly anyone gets lost to the portfolio of the city to the north and northwest of the city. Migrants in places like Volendam, which are almost not at all, live here in ghetto -noble relationships. It looks like another country - another facet of the Netherlands. Tobias Reckmann is also on the road here and learns that the different cultures have hardly any exchange among themselves. Leave the tourist paths, question clichés and discover a country and its people, who are supposed to be so familiar to us - and yet so differently. / Es ist eines der beliebtesten Urlaubslander der Deutschen. Schone Kusten, lebhafte und malerische Innenstadte, windgepragte Landschaften. Millionen Deutsche machen jedes Jahr Urlaub in den Niederlanden. Die Menschen dort: nett, offen und unkompliziert, so zumindest das Bild, das viele Deutschen von ihren Urlaubsreisen mitnehmen. "Lange war mein Eindruck, dass das, was aus den Niederlanden zu uns heruberschwappt, bunt, neuartig und manchmal etwas verruckt ist", sagt ARD-Korrespondent Tobias Reckmann. Aber: Bei der letzten Parlamentswahl haben 26 Prozent der Niederlander rechtspopulistische Parteien gewahlt, besonders viele die Partei von Geert Wilders; der selbst ist schon seit Jahren eine feste GroSSe in der niederlandischen Politik. Sind unsere Nachbarn also gar nicht so bunt und tolerant? Wie ticken sie wirklich?ARD-Niederlande-Korrespondent Tobias Reckmann will hinter die Kulissen der Urlaubsfassade schauen und reist nach Volendam. Die Kleinstadt liegt vor den Toren Amsterdams, ist landlich gepragt und eine Hochburg der Rechtspopulisten. Fischverkaufer Jaap Schilders Familie wohnt schon seit Generationen hier. Er wunscht sich in eine Zeit ohne EU-Fischfangquoten zuruck - und vor allem ohne Windrader in der Nordsee. "Die wurde ich am liebsten wieder abreiSSen", sagt er. Und auch sonst, wenn man mit ihm durch den Ort schlendert, begegnet man erstaunlich oft der Haltung "fruher war alles besser". Landwirte, die ihre Betriebe nicht auf klimaschonend umstellen wollen. Rentner, die befurchten, dass Zuwanderer ihre Fahrrader stehlen, und FuSSballfans, die es gut finden, eine verschworene Gemeinschaft zu sein, in der eben nicht einfach jeder mitmachen kann.Woher kommt die Sehnsucht nach fruher, der Wunsch, das Rad lieber wieder etwas zuruckzudrehen, anstatt womoglich noch weiter nach vorne?Viele berichten von einem rasanten Wandel, den das Land in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten durchgemacht hat. Ein extremes Bevolkerungswachstum und auch Zuzug - mittlerweile hat jeder Dritte in den Niederlanden einen Migrationshintergrund. Dem Land fehlen 400.000 Wohnungen. Jack Deen und Donna Schilders finden beide keine Wohnung - sie sind Mitte 20, haben Vollzeitjobs und konnen sich trotzdem den Auszug von zu Hause noch nicht leisten. So wie ihnen geht es Tausenden. Welche Perspektive haben sie?Nur wenige Kilometer von Volendam entfernt liegt Amsterdam. Die bunte, quirlige Metropole, die jedes Jahr von Millionen Touristen besucht wird. Doch von denen, die im Zentrum und entlang der Grachten unterwegs sind, verirrt sich kaum einer in den Norden und Nordwesten der Stadt, zu den Plattenbauvierteln. Hier leben vor allem Migranten, die in Orten wie Volendam fast gar nicht zu finden sind, in ghettoahnlichen Verhaltnissen. Es wirkt wie ein anderes Land - eine andere Facette der Niederlande. Tobias Reckmann ist auch hier unterwegs und erfahrt, dass die verschiedenen Kulturen kaum Austausch untereinander haben.Die Weltspiegel-Doku "Niederlande ungefiltert: Wer seid ihr wirklich?" verlasst die Touristenpfade, hinterfragt Klischees und entdeckt ein Land und seine Menschen, die uns vermeintlich so vertraut - und doch so anders - sind.

programme.desc: Only a few events have shaped the Federal Republic of Germany as the "escape summer" in 2015. On August 31, 2015, the then Chancellor Angela Merkel (CDU) pretended the course with the words "We can" do this ". The sentence became the credo of her escape policy in the self -imposed, huge task: hundreds of thousands of flights came to Germany after Merkel left the borders open in the late summer of 2015. the "Tagessehemen" moderator Ingo Zamperoni draws a balance: What did the "escape summer" do with our country in 2015? Did we make it? Where has integration succeeded and where are there problems? And how did the events to change the political landscape in Germany ten years ago? Ingo Zamperoni meets Chancellor a. D. Angela Merkel for an interview. Together they look in the summer of 2015 and how Germany has changed since then.ingo Zamperoni Spurt also the moods in the country. He hits the masters of Schwabisch Gmund, Richard Arnold (CDU), whose apparently inexperienced confidence seems to be lost and who speaks of having reached the load limit of his city. He accompanies Bavarian border police officers on the German-Easter border at a veil search and sees how the border controls have been intensified again. He visits the nurse Mohammed Alasaad in Cottbus, who came from Syria in early 2016 and has now trained other foster people. He drives to Solingen and gets a picture of what the knife attack did with the city a year ago. And he visits an escape accommodation that was presumably attacked by right -wing extremists. After all, he speaks to journalist Robin Alexander Daruber how the escape policy Angela Merkel has also politically changed our country. Documentation by author and director Birgit Warnke is raising the little stories and large political strange and arranges with the help of data: How many refugees are now in the works? How did the crime developed? How much violence is there against fleeing? And how many escape lodges have we taken up in the past ten years compared to other European countries? / Nur wenige Ereignisse haben die Bundesrepublik Deutschland so gepragt wie der "Fluchtlingssommer" 2015. Am 31. August 2015 gab die damalige Bundeskanzlerin Angela Merkel (CDU) den Kurs mit den mittlerweile fast schon historisch gewordenen Worten "Wir schaffen das" vor. Der Satz wurde zum Credo ihrer Fluchtlingspolitik bei der selbst auferlegten, gewaltigen Aufgabe: Hunderttausende Fluchtlinge kamen nach Deutschland, nachdem Merkel die Grenzen im Spatsommer 2015 offen lieSS, und sollten integriert werden.In der Doku "Merkels Erbe - 10 Jahre Wir schaffen das!" zieht der "tagesthemen"-Moderator Ingo Zamperoni eine Bilanz: Was hat der "Fluchtlingssommer" 2015 mit unserem Land gemacht? Haben wir es geschafft? Wo ist die Integration gelungen und wo gibt es Probleme? Und wie haben die Ereignisse vor zehn Jahren die politische Landschaft in Deutschland verandert?Fur die Doku trifft Ingo Zamperoni die Bundeskanzlerin a. D. Angela Merkel zu einem Interview. Gemeinsam blicken sie in den Sommer 2015 und darauf, wie sich Deutschland seitdem verandert hat.Ingo Zamperoni spurt zudem den Stimmungen im Land nach. Er trifft den Burgermeister von Schwabisch Gmund, Richard Arnold (CDU), dessen scheinbar unerschutterliche Zuversicht verloren zu gehen scheint und der davon spricht, die Belastungsgrenze seiner Stadt erreicht zu haben. Er begleitet bayerische Grenzpolizisten an der deutsch-osterreichischen Grenze bei einer Schleierfahndung und sieht, wie die Grenzkontrollen nochmals intensiviert wurden. Er besucht den Pfleger Mohammed Alasaad in Cottbus, der Anfang 2016 aus Syrien kam und mittlerweile andere Pflegekrafte ausbildet. Er fahrt nach Solingen und macht sich ein Bild, was der Messeranschlag vor einem Jahr mit der Stadt gemacht hat. Und er besucht eine Fluchtlingsunterkunft, die mutmaSSlich von Rechtsextremen angegriffen wurde. SchlieSSlich spricht er mit dem Journalisten Robin Alexander daruber, wie die Fluchtlingspolitik Angela Merkels unser Land auch politisch verandert hat.Die Dokumentation von Autorin und Regisseurin Birgit Warnke erzahlt die kleinen Geschichten und groSSen politischen Strange und ordnet mithilfe von Daten ein: Wie viele Gefluchtete sind inzwischen in Arbeit? Wie hat sich die Kriminalitat entwickelt? Wie viel Gewalt gibt es gegen Fluchtlinge? Und wie viele Fluchtlinge haben wir im Vergleich zu anderen europaischen Landern in den letzten zehn Jahren uberhaupt aufgenommen?

programme.desc: "Everything is new, everything is already," Mahsa Narimani Germany had imagined. programme.title: Hubert and Staller / Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Staller are witnessing a petrol station. The Rauber can flee, but the case seems to be drawn quickly: the DNA traces at the scene belong to Heiko Martens. There is only one problem: the man is dead! Martens was reported to be missing after a boat huck. And only officially explained for deceased for a short time. The grieving widow Sabine Jager-Martens hopes that her husband could still live. The Sister of the dead, Roswitha Martens, follows his very own theory: her brother Sabine wanted to kill Heiko, who was indebted, to get his life insurance at the time, but her attempt failed. Now her brother has returned to throat and prevent the money from paying out. Hubert and Staller suspect that the couple played off: Heiko wanted to get rid of his debts and only exchanged his death. Now he is back to sack life insurance with his wife. The two watch a meeting of the widow with a mysterious man. Is it Heiko? But when Hubert and Staller record the persecution, he escapes again. Then a determined video recording reveals: It is not the dead man that has caught the petrol station, but his sister! Has she exchanged, Heiko was still living so that the brother -in -law ends empty? But that doesn't make any sense. Because Roswitha continues to assert that her brother has her brother on her conscience, as the boat on which Martens is supposed to have a crash on is brought into play, Hubert and Staller have to ask whether the dead sister is not right ... / Hubert und Staller werden Zeugen eines Tankstellenuberfalls. Der Rauber kann fliehen, doch der Fall scheint schnell gelost: Die DNA-Spuren am Tatort gehoren zu Heiko Martens. Es gibt nur ein Problem: Der Mann ist tot! Martens wurde nach einem Bootsungluck als vermisst gemeldet und erst kurzlich offiziell fur verstorben erklart. Die trauernde Witwe Sabine Jager-Martens hegt Hoffnung, dass ihr Mann noch leben konnte. Die Schwester des Toten, Roswitha Martens, verfolgt eine ganz eigene Theorie: Ihre Schwagerin Sabine wollte den verschuldeten Heiko damals auf dem Boot umbringen, um an seine Lebensversicherung zu kommen, doch ihr Versuch schlug fehl. Jetzt ist ihr Bruder zuruckgekehrt, um sich zu rachen und die Auszahlung des Geldes zu verhindern. Hubert und Staller vermuten dahinter ein abgekartetes Spiel des Ehepaars: Heiko wollte seine Schulden loswerden und hat seinen Tod nur vorgetauscht. Nun ist er zuruck, um mit seiner Frau die Lebensversicherung einzusacken. Die beiden beobachten ein Treffen der Witwe mit einem mysteriosen Mann. Handelt es sich um Heiko? Doch als Hubert und Staller die Verfolgung aufnehmen, entkommt er erneut. Dann offenbart eine entschlusselte Videoaufzeichnung: Nicht der Tote hat die Tankstelle uberfallen, sondern seine Schwester! Hat sie vorgetauscht, Heiko wurde noch leben, damit die Schwagerin leer ausgeht? Doch so ganz ergibt das keinen Sinn. Denn Roswitha beteuert nach wie vor, dass ihre Schwagerin ihren Bruder auf dem Gewissen hat.Als dann auch noch das Boot, auf dem Martens verungluckt sein soll, ins Spiel gebracht wird, mussen sich Hubert und Staller fragen, ob die Schwester des Toten nicht doch recht hat ...

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn and Lars are pursuing a sports car, the driver of which is apparently minor year. The boy suddenly loses control over the car and accidentally loses. The seriously injured boy is Arthur Grun, the 14-year son of a Lubeck brothel owner, is accused of forced prostitution. Staatsanwaltin Zobel sieht sich gezwungen, ihn vom Dienst zu suspendieren. Der Junge hatte, wenn sie nach Vorschrift gehandelt hatten, nie eine Waffe ziehen konnen.Aber wieso hatte der Junge uberhaupt eine Waffe? Finn beginnt ohne Marke zu ermitteln. Bei dem schwerverletzten Jungen handelt es sich um Arthur Grun, den 14-jahrigen Sohn eines Lubecker Bordellbesitzers, dem Zwangsprostitution vorgeworfen wird. Wahrend Finn in Gefahr gerat, wegen seiner "privaten" Ermittlungen den Job zu verlieren, versucht Lars mehr uber Hauke Grun, Arthurs machtigen Vater, herauszufinden. Aber der will weitere Ermittlungen unbedingt verhindern und setzt zum Gegenschlag an.

programme.desc: The author and publisher Christoph (Heikko Deutschmann), who is as charming as well -lookeded as well as well -looked. And one day he leads to Christoph believes that he was dislocable to cancer - the treating doctor had only exchanged the Rontgenbild because Christoph had once again intervened in the consultation. From Reiner Fursorge, Christoph, Friederike, decides to keep his illness and secretly seek a successor. With involuntary support of his best friend, the Catholic Father Alois (Heinrich Schafmeister), he sees a tons of bizarre videos from candidates and even organizes a barbecue evening with three old school friends - all singles, but completely unusable. The left-wing esoteric freak Paul (Ingo Naujoks) still seems to have the most potential. So Christoph decides to "spice up" his old buddy with the help of the beauty consultant Suse (Tanja Schumann). Friederike is visibly irritated by this new manner friendship - the compliments and small flirts of the charming craftsman Klaus (Thomas Scharff) are just right. When her husband supposedly caught the two in flagranti, the events are overwhelmed: Christoph is admitted to the hospital after falling stairs, where he is already swaying on the death bed. At the same time, Friederike and Alois learn the truth about his supposed cancer, but Christoph has already stormed from the hospital to put an end to his life. Alois and Friederike have to put the gas in the truest sense in order to protect this imaginary patient from great stupidity. / Der ebenso charmante wie gut aussehende Autor und Verleger Christoph (Heikko Deutschmann) ist ein echter Perfektionist. Ob es um die von ihm verfassten Heimwerker-Ratgeber geht, um die Einrichtung seines Hauses oder um seine Ehe: Der treu sorgende Familienvater uberlasst nichts dem Zufall. Seine Frau Friederike (Aglaia Szyszkowitz) beobachtet die Kontrollsucht ihres Gatten mit einer Mischung aus Genervtheit und liebevollem Spott. Aber Christoph ist nicht nur ein besessener Perfektionist - er hat auch einen ausgepragten Hang zur Hypochondrie. Und der fuhrt eines Tages dazu, dass Christoph glaubt, unheilbar an Krebs erkrankt zu sein - dabei hatte der behandelnde Arzt lediglich das Rontgenbild vertauscht, weil sich Christoph in der Sprechstunde wieder einmal vorgedrangt hatte. Die wichtigste Frage fur den vermeintlich Todgeweihten lautet nun: Wie soll seine Familie ohne ihn weiterleben? Aus reiner Fursorge beschlieSSt Christoph, Friederike seine Krankheit zu verschweigen und heimlich per Kontaktanzeige einen wurdigen Nachfolger zu suchen. Mit unfreiwilliger Unterstutzung seines besten Freundes, des katholischen Paters Alois (Heinrich Schafmeister), sichtet er eine Unmenge skurriler Videos von Kandidaten und veranstaltet sogar einen Grillabend mit drei alten Schulfreunden - alle Singles, aber ganzlich unbrauchbar. Der linkische Esoterik-Freak Paul (Ingo Naujoks) scheint noch das meiste Potenzial zu haben. Also beschlieSSt Christoph, seinen alten Kumpel mit Hilfe der Beauty-Beraterin Suse (Tanja Schumann) ein wenig "aufzupeppen". Friederike ist sichtlich irritiert von dieser neuartigen Mannerfreundschaft - da kommen ihr die Komplimente und kleinen Flirts des charmanten Handwerkers Klaus (Thomas Scharff) gerade recht. Als ihr Mann die beiden vermeintlich in flagranti erwischt, uberschlagen sich die Ereignisse: Christoph wird nach einem Treppensturz ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert, wo er sich bereits auf dem Totenbett wahnt. Zur gleichen Zeit erfahren Friederike und Alois die Wahrheit uber seine vermeintliche Krebs-Erkrankung, aber Christoph ist bereits aus dem Hospital gesturmt, um seinem Leben ein Ende zu setzen. programme.title: Icons of Austria / Ikonen Österreichs
programme.desc: The Kasperl was once a coarse company, food, up-and-coming and drunk and with a clear slope to the observatory; What did not like the authorities, especially the Empress Maria Theresia. Nevertheless, a true "Kasperlmania" broke out in the second half of the 18th century. And in 1911 Felix Salten described a puppet show in the sausage praire, in whom the Kasperl first beats his wife, then the dead person and finally "the Jud" before being saved by an angel in front of the devil. After the Second World War he is no longer allowed to strike, but the little ones raise the little ones. Resumee of the Graz Germanist Beatrix Muller-Kampel: "Stubenrein, gently and well-behaved, he serves nuts and fathers as a funny kindergartner." In the "icons of Austria" series, objects are alive who have iconic importance for the history of the country. Whether important art objects or unspectacular things in everyday life: every object raised stories about themselves and the people who used it. / Einst war der Kasperl ein derber Gesell, fress-, rauf- und sauflustig und mit deutlichem Hang zum Obszonen; was den Obrigkeiten, allen voran der Kaiserin Maria Theresia, gar nicht gefiel. Dennoch brach in der zweiten Halfte des 18. Jahrhunderts eine wahre "Kasperlmania" aus. Und noch 1911 beschreibt Felix Salten ein Puppenspiel im Wurstelprater, bei dem der Kasperl erst seine Frau erschlagt, dann den Totenbeschauer und zuletzt "den Jud", bevor er von einem Engel vor dem Teufel gerettet wird. Nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg darf er nicht mehr zuschlagen, dafur aber die lieben Kleinen erziehen. Resumee der Grazer Germanistin Beatrix Muller-Kampel: "Stubenrein, sanft und brav geworden, dient er sich Muttern und Vatern als lustigmachender Kindergartner an."In der Reihe "Ikonen Österreichs" werden Gegenstande lebendig gemacht, die eine ikonische Bedeutung fur die Geschichte des Landes haben. Ob bedeutende Kunstgegenstande oder unspektakulare Dinge des Alltags: jedes Objekt erzahlt Geschichten uber sich und die Menschen, die es nutzten.

programme.title: The cultural week / Die Kulturwoche
Worldwide / WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Betonwusten. Wenn kein Gras mehr druber wachst?
programme.desc: The devastating consequences of the soil seal - this strangely seeming word - can be seen more clearly every year: floods because rain cannot seep up sufficiently, so -called heat islands with temperatures up to 60 degrees in the city because concrete and asphalt are heating up. And yet: around 12 hectares of soil - 17 football fields - are consumed on average per day in Austria. After a preliminary jerk, the flat woman has increased again since 2022. Soil consumption means that more and more green and agricultural land is lost due to construction for settlement and traffic purposes. Last year Austria was European champion in soil consumption. A sad record. And what does the balance sheet look like in our European environment? If the EU goal of reducing the soil consumption to zero by 2050 can still be achieved? Correspondent Diana Weidlinger is traveling in the Netherlands, where almost 18 million people live on a flat that is only half as big as Austria. The result: a soil consumption that lies in the European top field. She speaks to a urban planner about the possibilities of "clearing", learns from the Amsterdam water network operator, such as so -called "intelligent" roofers, the city guns from heat and floods, and helps with the so -called "tegwipps": a nationwide competition with the aim of removing and replacing so many old wash concrete slabs and stone clinker. The question of how it is in the Bevolzen -based Great Britain, which only has a very limited space, is the soil sealing balance. The city here eat much less into the surrounding area and the arterial is visibly less than in Austria or the Netherlands. How can that be? In the surrounding area of ​​the 9 million city of London, however, he also illuminates the downside of idyllic, unobstructed landscapes: the blatant lack of housing with the highest real estate prices in Europe. And he meets people in the huge Grungurtel around the British capital who want to prevent construction projects so that everything stays as it is: scenic protective for a high price. In Greece, correspondent Patrick A. Hafner follows the trace of money. On Mykonos, if you act an investment from 100 million euros, a building permit in the quick procedure. In the meantime there are 73 funf-star hotels on the small island and within the past ten years the sealed flat has quadrupled. The construction rage of the large investors now goes too far for the residents. The resistance to the sale of your homeland becomes bigger every day. But it is a struggle David against Goliath: The next major project on the last unobstructed section of the kust is to be realized at the end of the year: 55 bungalows with its own pool, without exception for a payment -ranging clientele. / Die verheerenden Folgen der Bodenversiegelung - dieses eigenartig anmutenden Wortes - kann man jedes Jahr deutlicher sehen: Hochwasser, weil Regen nicht ausreichend versickern kann, sogenannte Hitzeinseln mit Temperaturen bis uber 60 Grad in den Stadten, weil sich Beton und Asphalt aufheizen. Und trotzdem: rund 12 Hektar Boden - also 17 FuSSballfelder - werden in Österreich im Schnitt pro Tag verbraucht. Nach einem vorubergehenden Ruckgang hat der FlachenfraSS seit 2022 wieder zugenommen. Bodenverbrauch bedeutet, dass immer mehr Grun- und Agrarland durch Verbauung fur Siedlungs- und Verkehrszwecke verlorengeht. Vergangenes Jahr war Österreich Europameister im Bodenverbrauch. Eine traurige Bilanz. Und wie sieht die Bilanz in unserem europaischen Umfeld aus? Lasst sich das EU-Ziel, bis 2050 den Bodenverbrauch auf null zu senken, noch erreichen?Korrespondentin Diana Weidlinger ist in den Niederlanden unterwegs, wo knapp 18 Millionen Menschen auf einer Flache, die nur halb so groSS ist wie Österreich, leben. Die Folge: ein Bodenverbrauch, der im europaischen Spitzenfeld liegt. Sie spricht mit einem Stadtplaner uber die Moglichkeiten des "Entsiegelns", erfahrt vom Amsterdamer Wassernetzbetreiber, wie sogenannte "intelligente" Dacher die Stadt vor Hitze und Überschwemmungen schutzen, und packt beim sogenannten "Tegelwippen" mit an: ein landesweiter Wettbewerb mit dem Ziel, so viele alte Waschbetonplatten und Steinklinker wie moglich zu entfernen und durch Pflanzen zu ersetzen.Korrespondent Jorg Winter geht der Frage nach, wie es im bevolkerungsreichen GroSSbritannien, das nur sehr begrenzt Raum zu Verfugung hat, um die Bodenversiegelungsbilanz steht. Die Stadte hier fressen sich viel weniger ins Umland und die Zersiedelung ist sichtbar geringer als in Österreich oder den Niederlanden. Wie kann das sein? Im Umland der 9-Millionenstadt London beleuchtet er aber auch die Kehrseite idyllischer, unverbauter Landschaften: den eklatanten Wohnungsmangel mit den hochsten Immobilienpreisen Europas. Und er trifft im gewaltigen Grungurtel rund um die britische Hauptstadt Menschen, die Bauprojekte verhindern wollen, damit alles so bleibt, wie es ist: landschaftliche Schonheit fur einen hohen Preis.In Griechenland folgt Korrespondent Patrick A. Hafner der Spur des Geldes. Auf Mykonos bekommt, wer eine Investition ab 100 Millionen Euro tatigt, eine Baugenehmigung im Schnellverfahren. Inzwischen gibt es auf der kleinen Insel 73 Funf-Sterne Hotels und innerhalb der vergangenen zehn Jahre hat sich die versiegelte Flache vervierfacht. Den Einwohnern geht die Bauwut der GroSS-Investoren inzwischen zu weit. Der Widerstand gegen den Ausverkauf ihrer Heimat wird taglich groSSer. Doch es ist ein Kampf David gegen Goliath: das nachste GroSSprojekt am letzten unverbauten Kustenabschnitt soll bereits Ende des Jahres realisiert werden: 55 Bungalows mit eigenem Pool, ausnahmslos fur eine zahlungskraftige Klientel.

programme.title: On the rails of the double eagle - the way to the West / Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Der Weg in den Westen
programme.desc: A documentary by Gernot Stadler and Bjorn Kolzeine Production of ORF/3SATICH only for the emperor was muzzling and lengthy to cross Austria. With the expansion of a gigantic railway network, however, this was different. This was not only the imperial desire to travel. People and goods are plidies between the steppes of Galicia, the chest of the Adriatic and remote alpine valley. Whether salt from the Salzkammergut, Kase from the Bregenzerwald or Wine from today's Sudirol - the railway changed the economy and life in the much -fashioned realm enormously. The two directors Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler take the approaches on a trip to the sudwestern crownlanders of the Habsburg Empire. With the Kaiserin-Elisabeth-Bahn, today's Western Railway, we go to Bad Ischl and the Muhlviertel in Oberosterreich. From Innsbruck, the journey takes the Arlbergbahn to Vorarlberg and the Brennerbahn to Sudtirol. A locomotive park in the Upper Easter -Reicer Hausruckviertel is a visit to a visit, an exit with a historical steam locomotive is on the program in Karnten. One thing quickly becomes clear: it was the railways that flew the wide rich with life, transported people and goods over long distances and the conquest of landscapes in the tourist sense. In a large area, which is now occupied by more than a dozen sovereign states, travelers were able to move freely a hundred years ago without any fridge. The railroad also became a symbol for freedom and unity within the Austrian-Hungarian monarchy. December 8, 2015, 3Sat externs all three parts of the series "On the rails of the double eagle" from 2.10 p.m., before that it goes at 1:20 p.m. "with full steam to the K.U.K. Riviera". / Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn KolzEine Produktion von ORF/3satNicht nur fur den Kaiser war es muhsam und langwierig, das Kaisertum Österreich zu durchqueren. Mit dem Ausbau eines gigantischen Eisenbahnnetzes anderte sich das allerdings. Das kam nicht nur der kaiserlichen Reiselust entgegen. Menschen und Waren zirkulierten plotzlich zwischen den Steppen Galiziens, den Kusten der Adria und entlegenen Alpentalern. Ob Salz aus dem Salzkammergut, Kase aus dem Bregenzerwald oder Wein aus dem heutigen Sudtirol - die Eisenbahn veranderte die Wirtschaft und das Leben in dem Vielvolkerreich enorm.Die beiden Regisseure Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nehmen die Zuseher mit auf eine Reise in die sudwestlichen Kronlander des Habsburgerreiches. Mit der Kaiserin-Elisabeth-Bahn, der heutigen Westbahn, geht es nach Bad Ischl und ins Muhlviertel in Oberosterreich. Von Innsbruck aus fuhrt die Reise mit der Arlbergbahn nach Vorarlberg und mit der Brennerbahn nach Sudtirol.Beleuchtet werden dabei nicht nur bautechnische Meisterleistungen, sondern auch einzelne Regionen entlang der Reiseroute. Im oberosterreichischen Hausruckviertel ladt ein Lokpark zu einem Besuch ein, in Karnten steht eine Ausfahrt mit einer historischen Dampflok auf dem Programm.Eines wird rasch deutlich: es waren die Eisenbahnen, die das weite Reich mit Leben erfullten, die Menschen und Waren uber weite Strecken transportierten und die Eroberung von Landschaften im touristischen Sinne ermoglichten. In einem GroSSraum, der heute von mehr als einem Dutzend souveraner Staaten belegt wird, konnten sich Reisende vor hundert Jahren ohne jegliche Einschrankung frei bewegen. Die Eisenbahn wurde auch zu einem Symbol fur Freiheit und Einheit innerhalb der Österreichisch-Ungarischen Monarchie.Am 8. Dezember 2015 strahlt 3sat ab 14.10 Uhr alle drei Teile der Reihe "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" aus, davor geht es um 13.20 Uhr "Mit Volldampf an die k.u.k. Riviera".

programme.title: Experience Austria / Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Das Bleistatter Moor - Vom Moor zum Ackerboden zum Moor
programme.desc: The Bleitstatt Moor was once one of the greatest moor areas of Carnato with 600 hectares. In the course of hunger years in the interwar period, the moor was drained to use it for agriculture. As a result, trucks and dung agents with the flowering Tiebel were used unfiltered into the Ossiacher See. As a result, a massive algae plague developed in the lake. After multi -layered project coordinations, the Tiebel 75 hectares were flooded again from 2016 from 2016. As a filter, the removal basin reduces the entry of floating and nutrients into the Ossiacher See and thus once again raise the water quality, but today the large part of the dry-laid flat shares is still used for agriculture. The area around the flooded setting pools increasingly develops into a protected paradise for flora and fauna. And by the way, the species-rich nature, landscape and European protection area with the "Slow Trail" became a harmonious connection with the gentle tourism.The project Bleinstter Moor is the result of a wide range of cooperation between experts from the areas of water ecology, agriculture, nature conservation and tourism. / Das Bleistatter Moor war einst mit 600 Hektar eines der groSSten Moorgebiete Karntens. Im Zuge der Hungerjahre in der Zwischenkriegszeit wurde das Moor trockengelegt, um es landwirtschaftlich zu nutzen. Dadurch wurden Nahrstoffe und Dungemittel mit der durchstromenden Tiebel ungefiltert in den Ossiacher See gespult. In der Folge entwickelte sich im See eine massive Algenplage.So wurden nach vielschichtigen Projektkoordinationen ab 2016 im Mundungsbereich der Tiebel 75 Hektar wieder geflutet. Die entstandenen Absetzbecken verringern als Filter den Eintrag von Schweb- und Nahrstoffen in den Ossiacher See und heben somit wieder die Wasserqualitat.Heute wird der GroSSteil der trockengelegten Flachen im Rahmen des Naturschutzes nach wie vor landwirtschaftlich genutzt. Der Bereich um die gefluteten Absetzbecken entwickelt sich zunehmend zu einem geschutzten Paradies fur Flora und Fauna. Und nebenbei wurde das artenreiche Natur-, Landschafts- und Europaschutzgebiet mit dem "Slow Trail" zu einer harmonischen Verbindung mit dem sanften Tourismus.Das Projekt Bleistatter Moor ist das Ergebnis einer vieljahrigen Kooperation zwischen Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Gewasserokologie, Landwirtschaft, Naturschutz und Tourismus.

programme.title: Eco / Eco
programme.desc: Price premium - why we pay more when shopping than the German coffee, orange juice or fresh food: Many foods that we eat every day cost significantly more in Austria than in Germany - sometimes even twice. It is undisputed that there is this Austria surcharge. Why the prices are higher with us, but there are completely different views. Food trade and producers blame each other. Politicians are not a solution to get rid of the Austria premium. Consumers suffer. Where do the high prices really come from and what can be done about it? Report: Markus Preslmayr, Johannes Schwitzer Furnsensinstkampf for rare earth-how China The global tech industry on the gangle band holds are 17 elements that captivate the whole world: rare earth. Smartphones, catalysts, e-car engines or Windrader-nothing works without these metals. And China controls 90 percent of the market. Not only because it has the world-sized stocks, but also because it has been getting other producers out of the market for years through dumping prices. Now the global economy is getting the invoice: the dependence on China is becoming increasingly obvious. The prices are increasing and since April the SE export by China has also been subjected to strict concessions. How big is our dependence on rare earths really and what alternatives are there? Report: Hans Hrabalflug against Zug - puts the night train in the crisis? Once from Vienna to Rome - this is quick and cheap with the plane. But flying the environment is massive. The railway tries to counteract with environmentally friendly alternatives, especially with the expansion of international night train connections. But especially on long distances, rails are often not only more short, but also more time -consuming and more expensive. While the rail is considered the last mobility, the question arises: How competitive is the night train compared to the flight really - and what did others have to do so that it becomes a real alternative? Report: Ines Ottenschlager / Preis-Aufschlag - warum wir beim Einkaufen mehr zahlen als die DeutschenKaffee, Orangensaft oder Frischkase: viele Lebensmittel, die wir jeden Tag zu uns nehmen, kosten in Österreich deutlich mehr als in Deutschland - teilweise sogar das Doppelte. Dass es diesen Österreich-Aufschlag gibt, ist unbestritten. Warum die Preise bei uns hoher sind, dazu gibt es aber vollig unterschiedliche Ansichten. Lebensmittelhandel und Produzenten schieben sich gegenseitig die Schuld zu. Die Politik findet keine Losung, um den Österreich-Aufschlag loszuwerden. Die Verbraucher leiden. Woher kommen die hohen Preise wirklich und was kann dagegen getan werden? Bericht: Markus Preslmayr, Johannes Schwitzer-FurnsinnKampf um Seltene Erden - wie China die weltweite Tech-Industrie am Gangelband haltEs sind 17 Elemente, die die ganze Welt in ihren Bann ziehen: Seltene Erden. Smartphones, Katalysatoren, E-Auto-Motoren oder Windrader - nichts geht mehr ohne diese Metalle. Und China kontrolliert 90 Prozent des Marktes. Nicht nur, weil es die weltgroSSten Vorrate besitzt, sondern auch weil es seit Jahren durch Dumping-Preise andere Produzenten aus dem Markt drangt. Jetzt bekommt die Weltwirtschaft die Rechnung prasentiert: die Abhangigkeit von China wird immer offensichtlicher. Die Preise steigen und seit April wird der SE-Export durch China auch noch strengen Konzessions-Prufungen unterzogen. Wie groSS ist unsere Abhangigkeit bei seltenen Erden wirklich und welche Alternativen gibt es? Bericht: Hans HrabalFlug gegen Zug - steckt der Nachtzug in der Krise?Einmal von Wien nach Rom - das geht schnell und gunstig mit dem Flugzeug. Doch Fliegen belastet die Umwelt massiv. Die Bahn versucht, mit umweltfreundlichen Alternativen gegenzusteuern, insbesondere mit dem Ausbau internationaler Nachtzugverbindungen. Doch gerade auf langeren Strecken ist Bahn fahren oft nicht nur umstandlicher, sondern auch zeitintensiver und teurer. Wahrend die Schiene als Schlussel zur nachhaltigen Mobilitat gilt, stellt sich die Frage: Wie konkurrenzfahig ist der Nachtzug im Vergleich zum Flug wirklich - und was musste sich andern, damit er eine echte Alternative wird? Bericht: Ines Ottenschlager
